## 2. Professional Executive Summary
Gagah Athallah Fatha is a Business and Data Analyst with over 2 years of hands-on experience in research, data analytics, supply chain operations, enterprise technology, and AI innovation. He has a proven track record of translating complex datasets and corporate challenges into actionable executive insights.

Gagah's expertise encompasses:
- **Consulting & Strategic Deck Building**: Expert in structuring client-ready presentation decks, narrative synthesis, market research, and business opportunity framing.
- **Enterprise Software & ERP Systems**: Hands-on involvement in SAP, Ivalua, Odoo ERP, and custom-built Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
- **AI Automation & ML Architecture**: Developer of AI-powered solutions, including Narratio AI (converts raw data into structured consulting slide decks using LLMs & BiLSTM models) and localized internal RAG AI assistants.
- **Data & Quantitative Analytics**: Experienced in processing large-scale datasets (50,000+ records), probability-based predictive modeling, route optimization, and financial modeling.
